description: Extra information revealed on hover or focus of an element.

howToUse: Use it for a preview of a person, link or item when the pointer rests on it: profile, page summary, product.
Put the preview in `content`. Adjust `openDelay` so it does not open when the pointer just passes by.
The element that opens it must also work alone, such as a link to the full profile: touch screens have no hover.
alternatives: Content people need to act on: Popover.

keyboard.action: Focusing the element opens the card.

props.name: content
props.description: Rich preview shown when hovering the trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Reference that triggers the card (link, mention, avatar).

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Delay before opening, in ms. Default 500.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay before closing on leave, in ms. Default 200.
